g.text: Most sit near zero; the negative tail is enriched for TCR machinery, the positive tail is the candidate hypothesis space.

text.style: fill: #8fa39d; font: 11px 'Plus Jakarta Sans', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start

g.text: The positive side is not brake-enriched (Mann–Whitney p = 0.70) — a hypothesis space, not a validated set.
